Class-prototype method load: Benchmark's prototype object is created implicitly by class lowering and has no source-level production expression, so no prototype shape can be bound for it and the method lookup cannot be specialized.

results is an untyped local array: array literals cannot be shape-bound (the static-shape binding on [] auto-pruned as unmatched), and an added number guard on the results.length expression produced no optimization, so the length load stays on the generic property path.

String concat "Time: " + total: the only untyped operand is total; its number type guard at the concat operand (298:20) is silently dropped by the IR (it never appears in dryrun feedback, like other argument-position guards), and a guard on the declaration 296:9 auto-prunes as unmatched, so the generic ToPrimitive concat cannot be specialized.

Concat "Cannot find module '" + i + "'": i is a number when the shim dispatches module ids but a string for nested require calls, so no single concrete-type guard is sound; a use-site string type guard was tried and had no effect.
